svg.title: Topographic contours around Wānaka, New Zealand
svg.desc: Elevation contours calculated at 100 metre intervals from a 50 kilometre square centred on Wānaka.
svg.metadata: Centre -44.696, 169.136; width 50 km; generated 2026-09-25; terrain data from Mapzen Terrain Tiles via the Registry of Open Data on AWS, incorporating LINZ elevation sources for New Zealand.
